content.summary: ARS Pharmaceuticals (SPRY) announced that the National Medical Products Administration in China has granted approval for neffy 2 mg for the emergency treatment of Type 1 allergic reactions in adults and children who weigh 30 kg or more. ARS Pharma and Pediatrix Therapeutics anticipate filing for approval of neffy 1 mg dose for children greater than 15 kg and less than 30 kg in the coming months.
